args.title: Brightline Freight — Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Sources: Brightline Freight newsletter "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (newsletter@brightline.example); linked article https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain; subscriber-only companion https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion (opened with our team subscription code).

- Newsletter framing: this week's issue centers on cold-chain logistics in 2026, with the main analysis on the blog and a deeper companion piece reserved for subscribers.
- Main article finding: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data — and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage.
- Companion piece finding: pilots cut claims by a quarter (~25%), reinforcing that the payoff from live sensor data sharing shows up in claims/rejections more than in product loss.
